text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy grounds, I overheard a cheerful conversation among some horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I gotta admit. I totally underestimated it.
Sky's cat space... I had no idea it'd be that therapeutic!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's such a splendid little house, right~?
Toys♪ Cushions♪ Total feline bliss~♪
choice_data_list: (...Are they talking about the cat house we built earlier!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think word had spread this much.
Curious, I headed over to the spot where we built it...

text_block_list.name: Local Cats
text_block_list.text: Meow, meow, meoow~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kya~♡ This little one is sooo cute~!
I could pet you forever and ever~♡

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That one over there is so calm and composed.
Its lovely coat is just like fresh snow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The academy's horse girls were being thoroughly charmed and healed by the local cats living in the cat house!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Welcome, Trainer.
Did ya hear the rumors and come over~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan is hosting a "Cat Meet-and-Greet" today.
The healing power of cats is shared property... or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! Look, look, Onee-chan~!
The kitty is doing bunny kicks~!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Brown Tabby
text_block_list.text: Nya-nya!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... way too cute... this is heaven...♡
So sweet, it totally melts my heart♡

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I feel deeply relaxed as well.
Watching both the energetic Vivlos and the sweet kitty.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan... thanks for all your hard work, nya~♡
Come play together and get totally soothed♡

text_block_list.name: Energetic Brown Tabby
text_block_list.text: Meow-meow~♡

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man. Thanks a bunch, Grass-chan.
I invited ya, but I'm glad you actually showed up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. I was just thinking how nice it would be to spend a quiet, relaxing moment with some cats~.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Silver Tabby
text_block_list.text: ...Meo~~w.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It couldn't be more peaceful...
I completely understand why they were so beloved in ukiyo-e woodblock prints~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha♪ Glad to hear it.
Inviting ya was definitely worth it~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A proper balance between stillness and motion is essential in all things.
I shall spend some leisurely time catching my breath here today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky chatted casually about cats like always. However, knowing how she usually operates...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could she be gathering lots of horse girls to extract race intel from their conversations...? Her true aim remained a mystery, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well~. Everyone headed home with "Totally Satisfied!" written all over their faces~. Trainer included, all of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
That's 'cause you guys are just way too adorable, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Local Cats
text_block_list.text: Meo~w.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
When you were abandoned,
you were out in the pouring rain in a cardboard box... wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—A comfortable room and tasty meals.
I even arranged friendly horse girls to visit you, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Local Cats
text_block_list.text: Meo~w!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later. Feeling curious, I stopped by the cat house again...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Plenty of milk... check.
Feelin' good, kitty? Not cold, are ya~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Nyahahaha♪ Good kitty, good kitty...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There stood Seiun Sky all alone, looking at the cats with the gentlest gaze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Perhaps having all tension melted away by the cats, I slept like a log that night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I drifted off into the world of dreams... I once again truly appreciated the miraculous relaxing power of cats!
